_what_this_is: The invariant violations the adversarial QA harness found at commit 211aecc5, written
down so the test suite can stay green while the defects stay visible.
It is a ledger, not an excuse list. The test that reads it fails in BOTH directions:
an entry here that stops violating fails (somebody fixed it - remove the entry), and a
violation that is not here fails (something new broke). Neither direction can pass
quietly, which is the only thing that stops a file like this becoming a place where
This phase fixes nothing. Every entry is reported in docs/OI_ADVERSARIAL_QA_RUN.md
with its severity, its reproduction command and a regression candidate that a person
- not the harness - decides whether to promote.

violations.note: A question containing a timeframe silently repoints the monitor at it.
Two timeframes in one correction: the layer fails closed and the rejected value stays in force.
'Don't use 15m for this.' sets the timeframe to 15m.
'Anything but 15m please.' sets the timeframe to 15m.
'Not short.' sets the direction to short.
'Never use short.' sets the direction to short.
'Don't use short.' sets the direction to short.
'Never use BTCUSDT.' includes BTC/USDT instead of excluding it.
'Anything but BTCUSDT.' includes BTC/USDT instead of excluding it.
